ideas.pitch: An AI-powered municipal feedback aggregator that parses local Ottawa public consultation transcripts and council meeting logs to surface actionable community priorities for city planners.
ideas.title: OttawaCivicPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Local government and civic tech appeals strongly to regional hackathon judges in Ottawa by targeting immediate municipal utility without requiring complex proprietary integrations.

ideas.pitch: Real-time commuter analytics dashboard predicting OC Transpo bottleneck surges using historical scheduling data and live weather impacts.
ideas.title: CapitalTransitFlow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles a notorious local pain point for Ottawa residents and transit users, ensuring immediate relatability and high engagement from judges.

ideas.pitch: Satellite-based urban canopy monitoring tool that tracks tree cover health and heat island vulnerabilities across specific Ottawa neighborhoods.
ideas.title: CanopyOttawa
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes spatial analysis patterns similar to successful environmental monitoring projects, which score well on visual presentation and tangible climate impact.

ideas.pitch: Automated bill tracker and plain-language summary generator for federal legislation introduced in the Parliament of Canada.
ideas.title: ParliamentWatchAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the unique political geography of Ottawa, providing immediate value to researchers, journalists, and policy students.

ideas.pitch: Optimized route planning tool for snow removal and winter infrastructure maintenance contractors operating in Eastern Ontario.
ideas.title: WinterWorksOttawa
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on operational logistics tailored directly to the local climate realities of the region, demonstrating practical engineering utility.
